scope: SOS behavior and interface alignment with the manuscript
existing_behavior_verified: The mobile application submits current coordinates and the request time as a pending rescue request.
The ground station raises a notice for operator contact verification.
An SOS search event requires contact verification and explicit operator confirmation.
The separate Call 999 Now button opens the phone dialer.
changes: Updated the English and Chinese SOS instructions to describe ground-station operator verification.
Extended the existing SOS test to check the uploaded coordinates, request time, pending status, and database record path.
